items.source: AnnotationCustomizableTypeExcludeFilter that can be used to any test annotation that uses the standard includeFilters, excludeFilters and useDefaultFilters attributes.
items.translation: AnnotationCustomizableTypeExcludeFilter 可用于任何使用标准 includeFilters、excludeFilters 和 useDefaultFilters 属性的测试注解。

items.source: Test annotations support for TypeExcludeFilter.
items.translation: 测试注解支持 TypeExcludeFilter。

items.source: Abstract base class for a TypeExcludeFilter that can be customized using an annotation.
items.translation: 用于 `TypeExcludeFilter` 的抽象基类，可以通过注解进行自定义。

items.source: Uses of TypeExcludeFilter in org.springframework.boot.test.context.filter.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.boot.test.context.filter.annotation` 包中 `TypeExcludeFilter` 的用法
